# 0nCore — The AI Business Operating System

> Customer portal for 0nMCP. The dashboards, agents, automations, the LinkedIn bot, the HIPAA scanner, and 245 CRM tools — all powered by 0nMCP.

**Product:** 0nCore (0ncore.com)
**Vendor:** RocketOpp LLC
**Stack:** Next.js 16.1.6 · React 19.2.4 · Supabase · Stripe · Anthropic + Groq · 0nMCP v4.5.1

## What it is

0nCore is the front-end to [0nMCP](https://www.npmjs.com/package/0nmcp) — the open-source 1,554-tool AI orchestrator. Where 0nMCP gives developers an MCP server, 0nCore gives operators, agencies, and small businesses a polished SaaS dashboard backed by the same engine.

## Live features

### 0nLinkedIn — AI LinkedIn growth bot
Sales page + bot dashboard + Chrome extension feature. VPIS scoring (Velocity / Patterns / Intelligence / Signals), BE writing style enforcement, K-Social Intelligence Layer for algorithm modeling.

### CRM platform (245 tools)
Full leadconnectorhq.com integration. Contacts, calendars, opportunities, invoices, social, custom objects, payments — all reachable from the dashboard or via natural-language AI chat.

### HIPAA Scanner v2
**63 baseline checks** + **6 software supply chain checks** (via Spectra Assure / secure.software integration). 4 tiers:

| Tier | Price | Output |
|------|-------|--------|
| 1 | $149 | AI Readiness Report |
| 2 | $399 | Full Compliance Report |
| 3 | $499 | Premium Audit + Booking |
| 4 | $899 | Full Concierge + Live Walkthrough |

Magic-link auth for report access. Reports stored 6 years per 164.316(b).

### Chrome extension
v4.0.0, manifest v3, 186 files. Injects AI command palette into LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Reddit, Dev.to, ProductHunt, GitHub, Medium, YouTube. Multi-AI Council (Claude / GPT / Gemini / Grok). Voice-trained content generation.

### WordPress theme + plugin downloads
v1.0.0 of the OnPress + WP-SXO plugin family for WordPress site automation.

### Multi-channel automation
Email (Resend) + LinkedIn (custom bot) + WordPress (REST) + SMS (Twilio) + Voice (HeyGen agent).

### Migration tool
"Coming from X?" with 8 platform importers — bring your existing automations from Make, Zapier, n8n, Pabbly, Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop, and OpenAI configs.

## Architecture

- **129 pages, 235 API routes** (full SaaS dashboard)
- **CRM Agent Studio** integration via `CRM_AGENT_STUDIO_AGENT_ID=ac910cf1-7f20-48c3-915a-6df4847116ff`
- **K-layer AI** — 6 personas, 3 security levels, 7 K-layer crews (0nAI, 0nSocial, 0nBrand, 0nIntel, 0nSales, 0nComm, Web0n)
- **Database** — Supabase `pwujhhmlrtxjmjzyttwn` (shared with 0nmcp.com + marketplace + verifiedsxo)
- **Voice** — HeyGen avatar `9a160c504b8045a1b387e08e6d2918e1`, voice agent `d01e99a1-ed3f-4f24-b4d8-407009a165a7`
